status: Proposed UX. App implementation is unchanged in this mockup request.
principles: Large preview stays visible while adjusting one effect.
A shared precise picker uses source frames, not retimed playback positions.
Single moment effects use one marker; range effects use start and end handles.
Selecting an effect opens contextual controls rather than a full preset grid.
Frame Steps remains a review aid.
Reuse a confirmed contact frame across moment-based effects, with a per-effect override when needed.
Offer an automatic initial moment and range, then let the user refine them.

effects.timing: One impact frame with an effect duration
Selected range when the lens is visible
One freeze frame and an inserted hold duration
Individually selected source frames for review

engineeringNotes: Step to adjacent decoded presentation timestamps, including variable frame cadence.
Keep all ranges and selected frames on the original source timeline.
Apply camera controls to existing video pixels and reuse current detections; no new model.
Distinguish spatial selection of magnified pixels from the lens inset's screen placement.
